19977-the-blue-pavilions.title: The Blue Pavilions.
19977-the-blue-pavilions.creator: Unknown
19977-the-blue-pavilions.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. At noonday, on the 11th of October, 1673, the little seaport of Harwich, beside the mouth of the River Stour, presented a very lively appearance. More than a hundred tall ships, newly returned from the Dutch War, rode at anchor in the haven, their bright masts swaying in the sunshine above the thatched and red-tiled roofs of the town.

arxiv-2104-01286.title: Instance Level Affinity-Based Transfer for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation
arxiv-2104-01286.creator: Astuti Sharma Tarun Kalluri Manmohan Chandraker University of California San Diego {asharma,sskallur,mkchandraker}@eng.ucsd.edu
arxiv-2104-01286.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Astuti Sharma Tarun Kalluri Manmohan Chandraker University of California San Diego {asharma,sskallur,mkchandraker}@eng.ucsd.edu. Domain adaptation deals with training models using large scale labeled data from a specific source domain and then adapting the knowledge to certain target domains that have few or no labels. Many prior works learn domain agnostic feature representations for this purpose using a global distribution alignment objective which does not take into account the finer class specific structure in the source and target domains.

arxiv-2201-00777.title: Orienteering problem with time-windows and updating delay
arxiv-2201-00777.creator: Marc Demange, David Ellison, Bertrand Jouve
arxiv-2201-00777.description: Abstract The Orienteering Problem with Time Window and Delay ( OPTiWinD ) is a variant of the online orienteering problem. A series of requests appear in various locations while a vehicle moves within the territory to serve them. Each request has a time window during which it can be served and a weight which describes its importance.

arxiv-2207-12273.title: Analytic representations of two-loop scattering amplitudes with internal masses
arxiv-2207-12273.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by *. We highlight the latest developments in computing higher-order scattering amplitudes with massive internal propagators. The contributing Feynman integrals often lead to special classes of functions, for example, functions associated with elliptic curves. With the presence of more scales in the amplitudes, it becomes imperative to have a better understanding of the contributing Feynman integrals and using current cutting-edge technologies to tackle the growth in analytic and algebraic complexities.

arxiv-2305-08336.title: Inverse Rendering of Translucent Objects using Physical and Neural Renderers
arxiv-2305-08336.creator: Chenhao Li, Trung Thanh Ngo, Hajime Nagahara
arxiv-2305-08336.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Chenhao Li, Trung Thanh Ngo, Hajime Nagahara. In this work, we propose an inverse rendering model that estimates 3D shape, spatially-varying reflectance, homogeneous subsurface scattering parameters, and an environment illumination jointly from only a pair of captured images of a translucent object. In order to solve the ambiguity problem of inverse rendering, we use a physically-based renderer and a neural renderer for scene reconstruction and material editing. Because two renderers are differentiable, we can compute a reconstruction loss to assist parameter estimation.

arxiv-2504-17713.title: Target-Date Funds: A State-of-the-Art Review with Policy Applications to Chile’s Pension Reform
arxiv-2504-17713.creator: Fernando Suárez, José Manuel Peña, Omar Larré
arxiv-2504-17713.description: Abstract This review paper explores the evolution and implementation of target-date funds (TDFs), specifically focusing on their application within the context of Chile’s 2025 pension reform. The introduction of TDFs marks a significant shift in Chile’s pension system, which has traditionally relied on a multifund structure (essentially a target-risk funds system).

arxiv-2505-12889.title: Basis light-front quantization approach to deuteron
arxiv-2505-12889.creator: Chandan Mondal, Satvir Kaur, Jiatong Wu, Siqi Xu, Xingbo Zhao, James P. Vary, (BLFQ Collaboration)
arxiv-2505-12889.description: Abstract We obtain the deuteron’s wave functions as eigenstates of the light-front quantum chromodynamics (QCD) Hamiltonian using a fully relativistic and nonperturbative approach based on light-front quantization, without an explicit confining potential. These eigenstates include six-quark and six-quark–one-gluon components. The deuteron wave function consists of both a singlet-singlet color state and additional hidden color states arising from non-trivial color rearrangements.

arxiv-2511-02461.title: Ultrafast magnetic moment transfer and bandgap renormalization in monolayer FeCl 2 \text{FeCl}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{2}}}
arxiv-2511-02461.creator: Yu-Hui Song, Huan-Cheng Yang, Kai Liu, Zhong-Yi Lu
arxiv-2511-02461.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yu-Hui Song, Huan-Cheng Yang, Kai Liu, Zhong-Yi Lu. The microscopic origin of laser-induced ultrafast demagnetization remains an open question, to which the non-thermal electronic distribution plays a vital role at the initial stage. Herein, we investigate the connection between the non-thermal electronic distribution and the ultrafast spin dynamics as well as the electronic structure evolution in ferromagnetic FeCl 2 \text{FeCl}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{2}}} monolayer using real-time time-dependent density functional theory (rt-TDDFT) with self-consistent Hubbard U U correction.

arxiv-2511-09547.title: On vacuum and charged asymptotically (A)dS black holes in quadratic gravity
arxiv-2511-09547.creator: George Turner, Vojtěch Pravda, Alena Pravdová
arxiv-2511-09547.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by George Turner, Vojtěch Pravda, Alena Pravdová. In this paper, we study asymptotic properties of static spherically symmetric black holes in quadratic gravity with a cosmological constant Λ \Lambda . We find that for sufficiently large values of | Λ | |\Lambda| these black holes are generically asymptotically (A)dS and form a three-parameter family of black holes, with free parameters being the horizon radius, Λ \Lambda , and Bach parameter b b .

pmc-10554743.title: Dissecting the phase separation and oligomerization activities of the carboxysome positioning protein McdB
pmc-10554743.creator: Joseph L Basalla, Claudia A Mak, Jordan A Byrne, Maria Ghalmi, Y Hoang, Anthony G Vecchiarelli, Rohit V Pappu
pmc-10554743.description: Across bacteria, protein-based organelles called bacterial microcompartments (BMCs) encapsulate key enzymes to regulate their activities. The model BMC is the carboxysome that encapsulates enzymes for CO2 fixation to increase efficiency and is found in many autotrophic bacteria, such as cyanobacteria. Despite their importance in the global carbon cycle, little is known about how carboxysomes are spatially regulated.

pmc-11325036.title: Establishment of a stem cell administration imaging method in bleomycin-induced pulmonary fibrosis mouse models
pmc-11325036.creator: Saho Morita, Mayumi Iwatake, Sakura Suga, Kazuomi Takahashi, Kazuhide Sato, Chika Miyagi-Shiohira, Hirofumi Noguchi, Yoshinobu Baba, Hiroshi Yukawa
pmc-11325036.description: Pulmonary fibrosis is a progressive disease caused by interstitial inflammation. Treatments are extremely scarce; therapeutic drugs and transplantation therapies are not widely available due to cost and a lack of donors, respectively. Recently, there has been a high interest in regenerative medicine and exponential advancements in stem cell-based therapies have occurred.

pmc-12597825.title: Locityper enables targeted genotyping of complex polymorphic genes
pmc-12597825.creator: Timofey Prodanov, Elizabeth G Plender, Guiscard Seebohm, Sven G Meuth, Evan E Eichler, Tobias Marschall
pmc-12597825.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The human genome contains many structurally variable polymorphic loci, including several hundred disease-associated genes, almost inaccessible for accurate variant calling. Here we present Locityper, a tool capable of genotyping such challenging genes using short-read and long-read whole-genome sequencing. For each target, Locityper recruits and aligns reads to locus haplotypes, for instance, extracted from a pangenome, and finds the likeliest haplotype pair by optimizing read alignment, insert size and read depth profiles.

pmc-13239238.title: Microplastic Contamination in Salted Dried Beef
pmc-13239238.creator: Brenda Serrão de Freitas, Gabriel dos Anjos Guimarães, Gustavo Frigi Perotti, Beatriz Rocha de Moraes, Rômulo Augusto Ando, Gustavo Yomar Hattori, Bruno Sampaio Sant’Anna
pmc-13239238.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Plastic pollution is considered a major environmental challenge, and microplastics may pose risks to ecosystems and human health. This study investigated the presence of microplastics in salted dried beef sold in two cities in the Central Amazon, Brazil. Six brands, three sold in Itacoatiara and three sold in Parintins, were analyzed using density separation, organic matter digestion, stereomicroscopy, and Raman spectroscopy. All the samples showed contamination by microplastics, totaling 141 particles.

pmc-13290338.title: Field evaluation of Nepeta cataria–based biopreparation delivered via an automated spraying system for sustainable control of cattle ectoparasites under pasture conditions
pmc-13290338.creator: Gulzhan Yeszhanova, Rashit Uskenov, Saule Bostanova, Igor Tretyakov, Alibek Mutushev, Arman Mirmanov, Fariza Zhagipar, Lyudmila Lider
pmc-13290338.description: Background and Aim:Ectoparasites are a major constraint to cattle productivity, welfare, and health under pasture conditions. Conventional chemical control methods are increasingly limited by the development of resistance, environmental contamination, and residue accumulation in animal products. Plant-derived insecticidal formulations combined with precision livestock technologies represent a promising alternative.
